<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const pastPresentations = document.querySelector("#selected-past ul");

  document.querySelectorAll("#upcoming-presentations [data-presentation-cutoff]").forEach((presentation) => {
    const cutoff = new Date(`${presentation.dataset.presentationCutoff}T23:59:59`);

    if (new Date() > cutoff && pastPresentations) {
      presentation.removeAttribute("data-presentation-cutoff");
      pastPresentations.prepend(presentation);
    }
  });

  const upcomingSection = document.querySelector("#upcoming");
  if (upcomingSection && !upcomingSection.querySelector("li")) {
    upcomingSection.remove();
  }
});
</script>
